name: ui-alert
description: Bootstrap alert: theme colours, icon, heading, dismissible with fade-out.

descriptions.--bs-alert-gap: Space between icon, content and close button.
descriptions.--bs-alert-bg: Background without a theme colour (with one: the theme's subtle background).
descriptions.--bs-alert-color: Text colour without a theme colour (with one: the theme's foreground).
descriptions.--bs-alert-border-color: Border colour without a theme colour (with one: the theme's border).
descriptions.--bs-alert-link-color: Colour of .alert-link links in the body.
descriptions.--bs-alert-transition-property: Properties animated when the alert closes.
